precision_invariants: Scale reduction propagates NaN explicitly and preserves signed infinity masks. Rounding remains half-even with existing AscendQuant behavior; y tolerance<=1.
Scale MERE<2^-13 and MARE<10*2^-13 with exact NaN/Inf masks. No finite-input assumption or value-dependent dispatch.
semantic_invariants: Each last-axis token quantizes independently: scale=max(abs(x)).clamp(min1e-12)/127; y=clamp(round(x/scale),-128,127) as int8.
Scale output is FP32 and y is original row-major int8; each token has one owner; no cross-token reduction.
Supported rank2..8, row length1..16384, half/BF16 input. Preserve token and y store alignment at core boundaries.
